metadata.title: 게임수학 Part 2 · 렌더링 ② 카메라의 시야·줌·출력 창 이해하기
metadata.description:
같은 세계를 보고 있는데, 카메라를 옮기는 것과 줌을 바꾸는 것은 왜 다를까요? 먼저 실제 분할 화면을 보며 카메라와 출력 창을 나누고, 픽셀 비율을 계산하겠습니다. 이어서 시야각과 줌을 숫자로 연결하고, 카메라를 앞으로 옮기는 경우와 비교합니다. 마지막에는 직교 투영과 분할 화면 예제를 풀어, 어떤 값을 바꿔야 할지 직접 판단해 보겠습니다.

📚 게임수학 PART2 수업 자료

englishMetadata.title: Game Math Part 2 · Rendering 2: Camera View, Zoom and Output Windows
englishMetadata.description:
Why do moving a camera and changing its zoom give different views of the same world? First, real split-screen gameplay will help separate cameras from output windows, followed by a pixel-aspect calculation. Then we connect field of view with zoom numerically and compare that with moving the camera forward. Finally, orthographic projection and a split-screen exercise will show which parameters to change.

📚 Game Math PART2 course materials
YamYamWiki · Game Math PART2
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/1ea0b1ff-a61e-803f-bd54-cac4f028f6b3

YamYamCoding website
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/

YamYamWiki course notes
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/0d2adf45-5d1a-43be-a37c-61c94b1ae2c8

A full Game Math Part2 lecture with40% actual gameplay and60% explanation, narrated without background music.

Chapters
00:00 Lecture overview
00:57 Render targets and output rectangles
01:47 Image aspect versus physical pixel aspect
03:53 A camera sees a spatial volume
04:28 Six clipping planes and half-spaces
06:34 Field of view and half angles
07:14 Calculate a two-times zoom
08:34 Connect two FOV axes through aspect
10:04 Moving forward versus changing zoom
10:51 Sensor size and focal length
13:30 Parallel rays in orthographic projection
14:09 Orthographic box size and scale
15:41 Two output-window and scale problems
17:11 What to remember
17:57 Membership thanks and programming coaching

🎮 Build games with real programming skills.
